verdict.rationale: Fellow has a built-in AI assistant (Ask Fellow), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Fellow as an MCP server that external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Fellow itself can plug in third-party MCP servers or call their tools, and the server-side role does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
